description: Stations de Gaz naturel pour véhicules (GNV) publiques en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by paysdelaloire.opendatasoft.com. This dataset presents the NGV stations open to the public and planned in France with their characteristics (year of opening, operator, location, CNG and/or LNG pumps, payment methods... etc.). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Natural gas stations for public vehicles (NGV) in Pays de la Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TEO, Tableau de Bord Régional, LOM. The listing shows 2024-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
